title: Algebra-linear Koszul comparison for a regular immersion
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a Koszul-regular closed immersion into a Noetherian scheme, with r a locally constant function equal to the conormal stalk finrank. Put A=i_*OZ and g:(Z,OZ)→(Y,A), using [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Choose derived categories of modules on Z, on Y and over A, with independent morphism universes. If H is any right adjoint of the derived scalar restriction D(A)→D(OY), there is an isomorphism in D(A) from Rg_* of the explicit rank-stratified normal determinant complex to H(OY). No geometric quasi-coherent right adjoint is assumed. The scheme, closed immersion, Koszul-regular sequence, ideal sheaf, pullback, derived category, direct image, internal sheaf Hom, rank-stratified complex and stalk are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-pc-derived-category], [def-pc-derived-direct-image], [def-pur-sheaf-hom], [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], [def-pc-module-stalk-functor].

proof.text: Use the affine algebra-valued derived Hom adjunction and uniqueness of right adjoints to compute the specified scalar right adjoint H at OY by Hom(i_*OZ,J) for a K-injective resolution J, with i_*OZ acting by precomposition. On an affine chart along Z use the finite free Koszul model of the quotient to compute this cohomology.

The intrinsic dual-Koszul comparison identifies the only nonzero cohomology, in the local rank degree, with the top exterior power of the dual conormal as a quotient-algebra module. Precomposition by multiplication gives the usual quotient scalar action. Use the affine module correspondence and affine cohomology formula to identify the same module as algebra-valued derived direct image of the determinant. The stalk-rank hypothesis identifies the Koszul length with r.

Localization compatibility and independence of regular generators of the intrinsic comparison make the algebra-linear cohomology maps agree on intersections. Glue these maps as sheaf maps. Noetherian Z is quasi-compact, so r has finite image. Characteristic sections of the finitely many clopen rank strata on Z give orthogonal idempotents of i_* OZ with sum one. Split both algebra-module complexes by these idempotents, truncate each rank-n summand to its only nonzero cohomology degree n, and take the finite sum of the resulting isomorphisms. The rank strata need not be clopen in Y; the splitting uses the algebra action, not open subsets of Y. Outside Z both sides vanish. Transport by uniqueness to the specified right adjoint H. This establishes the comparison for any chosen derived categories, including independent universes for Z and Y.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_algebraDual {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wZ} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))]
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z, r z = Module.finrank (Z.presheaf.stalk z)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)))
    (H : schemeDerivedCategory Y ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
    (adjH : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
      (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))
      ⟨Functor.whiskerRight i.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).rightDerivedFunctor ⊣ H) :
    Nonempty ((RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage
      (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj ((DerivedCategory.Q (C :=
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorComplex
            (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
              (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) r)) ≅
        H.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)))
